title: SmartAgri UGM and PT. BISI International Tbk Inaugurate Smart Greenhouse System in Magelang, Driving IoT-Based Superior Seed Production
excerpt: Magelang, June 16, 2025 – Smart Agriculture Research Center UGM has successfully completed the installation of Smart Greenhouse systems and equipment at PT. BISI International Tbk's agricultural facility, Farm Grabag, Magelang. The inauguration and final project presentation was attended directly by the President Director of PT. BISI International, Tbk, Mr. Agus Saputra Wijaya, marking the company's progress in adopting precision agriculture technology.
body:
**Magelang, June 16, 2025** – Smart Agriculture Research Center UGM has successfully completed the installation of Smart Greenhouse systems and equipment at PT. BISI International Tbk's agricultural facility, Farm Grabag, Magelang. The inauguration and final project presentation was attended directly by the President Director of PT. BISI International, Tbk, Mr. Agus Saputra Wijaya, marking the company's progress in adopting precision agriculture technology.

The overarching objective of this project is to **prepare the production of superior seeds, particularly for tomato commodities**. This integrated system harnesses Internet of Things (IoT) technology and data-driven systems to monitor and automatically control various environmental parameters within the greenhouse, thereby optimizing plant growth conditions and supporting sustainable horticultural innovation.

During the final presentation, the development team presented the system's functionality, which encompasses the optimization of growing conditions and support for sustainable horticultural innovation. With this system in place, PT. BISI International, Tbk is expected to increase operational efficiency, reduce harvest failure risks, and produce agricultural products with more consistent quality and superior characteristics.

Mr. Agus Saputra Wijaya expressed his appreciation for the implementation of this technology, affirming PT. BISI International, Tbk's commitment to adopting innovation to advance Indonesia's agricultural sector. "The installation of this Smart Greenhouse is concrete evidence of our commitment to continue innovating and implementing cutting-edge technology for more efficient and sustainable agriculture, especially in producing superior seeds," said Mr. Agus Saputra Wijaya.

With the operation of this Smart Greenhouse, Smart Agriculture Research Center UGM and PT. BISI International, Tbk further strengthen their position as pioneers in the application of modern agricultural technology in Indonesia, supporting the vision of sustainable and globally competitive agriculture.

original.body:
**Magelang, 16 Juni 2025** – Smart Agriculture Research Center UGM telah sukses merampungkan pemasangan sistem dan peralatan Smart Greenhouse di fasilitas pertanian PT. BISI International Tbk, Farm Grabag, Magelang. Peresmian dan presentasi akhir proyek ini dihadiri langsung oleh Presiden Direktur PT. BISI International, Tbk, Bapak Agus Saputra Wijaya, menandai langkah maju perusahaan dalam mengadopsi teknologi pertanian presisi.

Tujuan besar dari proyek ini adalah untuk **menyiapkan produksi benih unggul, terutama untuk komoditas tomat**. Sistem yang terintegrasi ini memanfaatkan teknologi Internet of Things (IoT) dan sistem berbasis data untuk memantau dan mengontrol berbagai parameter lingkungan di dalam rumah kaca secara otomatis, sehingga dapat mengoptimalkan kondisi pertumbuhan tanaman dan mendukung inovasi hortikultura berkelanjutan.

Dalam presentasi akhir, tim pengembang memaparkan fungsionalitas sistem yang mencakup optimasi kondisi tumbuh dan dukungan inovasi hortikultura berkelanjutan. Dengan adanya sistem ini, PT. BISI International, Tbk diharapkan dapat meningkatkan efisiensi operasional, mengurangi risiko kegagalan panen, serta menghasilkan produk pertanian dengan kualitas yang lebih konsisten dan unggul.

Bapak Agus Saputra Wijaya dalam kesempatan tersebut menyampaikan apresiasinya terhadap implementasi teknologi ini, menegaskan komitmen PT. BISI International, Tbk dalam mengadopsi inovasi untuk memajukan sektor pertanian Indonesia. “Pemasangan Smart Greenhouse ini adalah bukti nyata komitmen kami untuk terus berinovasi dan menerapkan teknologi terkini demi pertanian yang lebih efisien dan berkelanjutan, khususnya dalam menghasilkan benih unggul,” ujar Bapak Agus Saputra Wijaya.

Dengan beroperasinya Smart Greenhouse ini, Smart Agriculture Research Center UGM dan PT. BISI International, Tbk semakin memperkuat posisinya sebagai pelopor dalam penerapan teknologi pertanian modern di Indonesia, mendukung visi pertanian berkelanjutan dan berdaya saing global.
